Subject: Renewal: Hosted API - capacity & pricing questions

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Retaily is preparing for the seasonal push and we expect a notable uplift in inference volume (estimate: +3.6x monthly tokens over baseline) starting in October. Procurement asked me to confirm a few items before we proceed with the renewal:

- Can you outline the committed monthly token bands you recommend for a 12-month renewal vs a 24-month term?
- What are the hard rate limits per minute for our current hosted plan and what changes if we move to a higher band?
- Do you offer a temporary burst or credit while the new commit takes effect (we may need a 2–3 week overlap)?

We're aiming to get terms signed by the end of August to align billing with our fiscal quarter. Rajesh (cc) will handle PO/contract.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

Lena Park
Director, Platform Integrations
Retaily

Subject: Re: Renewal: Hosted API - capacity & pricing questions

Lena — thanks for the heads up and welcome, Rajesh.

Short answers up front and a proposed next step below:

1) Recommended commit bands
- 12-month term: 1.5x of your current 90-day run-rate (safety buffer) with a 25% discount on incremental tokens at the next band.
- 24-month term: 1.3x run-rate baseline with a higher tier discount (35%) and a price lock for 18 months.

2) Rate limits and throttles
- Current plan (sustained): 600 RPS across tokenized requests, burst ceiling 1200 RPS for short windows (30s).
- Upgraded band (mid): sustained 1200 RPS, burst 2400 RPS with priority routing on our dedicated pools.
- Upgraded band (high): sustained 2200 RPS, burst 4400 RPS + SLA-backed latency targets.

3) Temporary burst/overlap
- We can provide a 21-day burst credit pool (subject to purchase of the first invoice) to cover ramp windows; this is typically applied as a one-time credit and does not modify the committed baseline.

Proposal & next steps
- Attached: retaily_redwood_proposal_v3.pdf (pricing and technical appendix).
- If you confirm the target band and term, I'll prepare an updated SOW and DocuSign envelope for signature. If you want to accelerate, we can schedule an ops kickoff to enable the burst window in parallel.

Can you confirm: (a) target monthly commit band, (b) preferred term length (12 vs 24), and (c) procurement timeline? Once I have that I'll loop in Billing and our Onboarding PM.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
